audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows are wrong on both layers. Packet is Garen, Garen, Skill, Wukong, Wukong, Skill, Skill; the pages read Wukong, Skill, Skill, Skill, Wukong, Skill, Wukong. Level 1 is the worst of them — the page gives it to Wukong at 3.5/10 while the prose says Garen wins it.
audit.why: whys[0] 'Garen out-trades a comboless Wukong with the Q-silence hit', whys[1] 'your poke still wins before his clone and Nimbus come online', whys[3] 'At 4 his Trickster clone and Nimbus burst flip the trades to him', whys[6] 'the duel settles roughly even'. The early prose likewise opens 'You take the first two levels'. Packet and prose agree row for row; only the tokens are wrong.
audit.corrected: Level 1 and Level 2 -> Garen 6/10; Levels 4-5 -> Wukong 4/10; 2+ items -> Skill 5/10. Level 3, Level 6 and First item already match.

audit.why: The four spikes land where the corrected chart says they should: Garen ahead 1-2, Wukong's combo spike at 4-5, level 6 Cyclone, and an even item-stage duel. spikes[3].when 'Late' matches the 2+ items row now reading Skill.
audit.corrected: No structural change; spikes[0] was reworded only to add the burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page says Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset, so the player is told to watch for a cast that never appears.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags this exact rule for this exact matchup: his combo opens on an auto-attack reset, which means the attack wind-up is the tell, not an ability animation. That changes when you step back — you have to react a beat earlier than a cast bar would let you.
audit.corrected: Name Crushing Blow as the reset and make the wind-up the cue in both Common Mistakes and the level 4-5 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', sequencingCues is 0. All-In Windows says only 'commit on Nimbus Strike's cooldown' with no number.
audit.why: The brief's enemyKit is null for Wukong, so I have no verified Wukong cooldowns to quote. Garen's own are in the ownerKit and are just as actionable: Courage is 22s at rank 1 falling to 12s at rank 5, and Judgment is 9s at rank 1 falling to 6s.
audit.corrected: Sequence the all-in off Garen's own verified cooldowns rather than an unverified enemy number.

edits.before: Spin the clone. Trade into his Q shred. Extend into his R knockup. And keep the ultimate holstered until a kill is actually on the table.
edits.after: Spin the clone. Trade into his Q shred — Crushing Blow is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Extend into his R knockup.

edits.before: Commit on Nimbus Strike’s cooldown, at your level/item spikes, and with jungle setup — bait his answer before you spend yours.
edits.after: Never commit without Courage: it is 22s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5. Judgment is 9s at rank 1 — open only when both are up.

edits.before: At 4 Wukong's Warrior Trickster clone plus Nimbus Strike burst out-trades you; the decoy eats your Q dash and E while he crashes back in with armor-shredding autos.
edits.after: At 4 the Warrior Trickster decoy eats your Judgment while he re-enters with Nimbus Strike; Crushing Blow is an auto reset, so his wind-up — not a cast bar — is your cue to back.

notes: Level-chart edits proposed as one atomic group (content win[0], win[1], win[3], win[6] plus full phases[0]/[1]/[3]/[6] side+rating); after the flip both layers match the packet chart row for row.
